title: GitHub - cezarc1/podcast_dub: Open-weight only, video-aware podcast dubbing with ASR alignment, diarization, LLM translation, and voice-cloned TTS. Local inference.
excerpt: Open-weight only, video-aware podcast dubbing with ASR alignment, diarization, LLM translation, and voice-cloned TTS. Local inference. - cezarc1/podcast_dub
content_html:
Dubs a video podcast into another language using all open-weight models.

The pipeline can run mostly locally on an M-series Mac with at least 16 GB of RAM. Translation is the main constraint, as larger LLMs (over 70 billion parameters) generally produce significantly better results. Feel free to experiment with different LLMs and configurations!

  • caption-free speech timing
  • automatic speaker separation (diarization)
  • fluent LLM translation
  • voice-cloned TTS per speaker (up to 4 speakers)
  • the original audio kept underneath, deep-ducked

Demo

Original English dub
Watch original Watch English dub

Dub a local video

Note: You need Git, uv, and FFmpeg pre-installed.

git clone https://github.com/cezarc1/podcast_dub.git
cd podcast_dub
uv sync --locked --python 3.12

Then, from the repository root:

uv run podcast_dub "./interview.mp4" --from zh --to en

Translation defaults to Kimi K3 through Moonshot's OpenAI-compatible API. DUB_TRANSLATE_API_KEY must already be set to the corresponding API key.

The complete pipeline runs and writes:

Path Contents
./interview_en.mp4 final dubbed video
./interview_dubwork/dub_mix.wav complete soundtrack with the original audio ducked underneath
./interview_dubwork/dub_voice.wav synthesized voices only
./interview_dubwork/ resumable stage artifacts, logs, and subtitles

The first run downloads the model weights and can take a while. Local inputs must be media files that FFmpeg can decode. HTTP(S) video URLs are also accepted and downloaded into the workdir with yt-dlp.

Use a job file

For a repeatable job, create dub.toml:

video = "./interview.mp4"
source_lang = "zh"
target_lang = "en"
output = "./interview_en.mp4"
context = "A technical interview about database performance."
proper_nouns = ["AcmeDB", "Nova"]
speaker_names = ["host", "guest"]
# Names are assigned from most to least detected speaking time.

Then run:

uv run podcast_dub --config dub.toml

See dub.toml.example for the configuration template. The demo above has ready-to-run configs for a five-minute development run and the full showcase.

Rerunning the same job reuses matching stage artifacts. If the source file's contents change without its filename changing, choose a fresh --workdir so the extracted source audio cannot be reused. Version 0.1 does not yet include the ASR/NeMo helper dependency locks in artifact provenance, so also use a fresh workdir after changing the installed model or inference dependencies.

Configure translation

Moonshot and Kimi K3 are the defaults. To use another OpenAI-compatible service, such as OpenAI, OpenRouter, or Ollama, set the endpoint, model, and key together:

export DUB_TRANSLATE_BASE_URL="https://provider.example/v1"
export DUB_TRANSLATE_MODEL="provider-model-id"
export DUB_TRANSLATE_API_KEY="<translation-api-key>"

DUB_TRANSLATE_BASE_URL is the API base URL; do not include /chat/completions. The pipeline appends the operation path. A non-empty key is still required when a local endpoint ignores authentication, so use the placeholder value documented by that endpoint.

For a repeatable job, llm_base and llm_model can instead be set in dub.toml; the environment variables override those values for one-off runs. Keep the key in DUB_TRANSLATE_API_KEY rather than storing it in the job file.

The configured endpoint must speak the OpenAI-compatible protocol. A direct Anthropic Messages API URL is not supported; use an OpenAI-compatible gateway such as OpenRouter to run Claude models.

Install

Prerequisites: Python 3.12, uv, and FFmpeg (ffmpeg and ffprobe).

macOS / Apple Silicon

uv sync --locked --python 3.12

The automatic stage plan is ASR on MPS, Sortformer diarization on CPU, and TTS on MPS. FlashAttention is not used on macOS.

Linux / NVIDIA CUDA

Confirm the NVIDIA driver works before installing:

nvidia-smi
uv sync --locked --python 3.12 --extra cuda

Linux currently resolves the project's pinned CUDA 13.0 PyTorch wheels. --extra cuda additionally installs FlashAttention for the main TTS environment; it is not GPU auto-detection.

One environment

Every stage runs in the single environment uv sync creates. There are no helper environments to build and nothing to configure after the sync.

ASR, TTS and diarization all run on Transformers 5.x. That needs two things: qwen-tts-compat, a fork of qwen-tts carrying the Transformers 5.x port (upstream hard-pins 4.57.3), and a [tool.uv] override-dependencies entry, because NeMo declares transformers~=4.57.0. That pin is conservative rather than load-bearing here: diarizing the same audio under 4.57.3 and 5.14.1 yields byte-identical segments.

The override is a uv-only mechanism — pip has no equivalent, so install with uv sync, not pip install.

DUB_ASR_PYTHON and DUB_NEMO_PYTHON still work if you would rather run either stage in its own interpreter; point them at it and that stage runs there.

Pipeline

video → probe (16 kHz audio) → ASR timing → diarization → clone refs → translation → TTS → placement + mix → mp4

Stage What runs Notes
probe ffmpeg extracts mono 16 kHz audio
asr Qwen3-ASR-1.7B + Qwen3-ForcedAligner caption-free phrase + word timings
diarize NVIDIA Sortformer (NeMo) up to four speakers; splits phrases at sustained speaker handoffs to reduce cross-speaker TTS
refs auto-mined from diarization ~60 s clean solo audio per speaker, full timeline
translate DSPy + kimi-k3 (Moonshot default) repairs spoken-ASR noise, uses preceding source conversation turns, emits TTS-ready speech, and logs every batch to <workdir>/translations.jsonl
tts Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B (local) stage-specific CUDA/MPS/CPU selection, x_vector-only voice cloning, measurement-verified DSPy.Refine rewrite loop
place ffmpeg + fit.py + verification anchored chaining, hard anti-drift windows, capped speedups only, sidechain-ducked original bed; publishes the mp4 only after coverage/dead-air verification passes

The CLI resolves and prints a stage-specific plan before doing model work:

Available accelerator ASR auto Diarization auto TTS auto
NVIDIA CUDA CUDA CUDA CUDA
Apple MPS MPS CPU MPS
none CPU CPU CPU

MPS and CPU use eager attention. CUDA ASR and TTS select FlashAttention 2 when it is installed and importable, otherwise SDPA; Sortformer does not consume that attention setting. Set asr_device, diarize_device, and tts_device explicitly in TOML when a particular accelerator is required.

These are fail-fast routing rules, not a promise that every driver and package combination works. Confirm nvidia-smi before a CUDA job and run the final media verifier on every completed dub.

The pinned TTS model supports zh, en, ja, ko, de, fr, ru, pt, es, and it as target languages. Reference mining requires at least 30 seconds of clean solo speech per detected speaker, so very short or heavily overlapping clips fail fast instead of producing a weak voice clone.

Placement runs the coverage and dead-air gates automatically. They can also be run directly when inspecting an existing workdir:

uv run python -m podcast_dub.stages.verify <workdir>

Repo layout

  • src/podcast_dub/ — the installable package: cli.py (console entry point podcast_dub), types.py (Pydantic contracts), artifacts.py (versioned/provenance-aware I/O), config.py, translate.py (DSPy programs), and the pipeline stages in stages/ (asr, diarize, refs, translate, tts, place, verify)
  • src/podcast_dub/fit.py, device_utils.py, audio_utils.py — timing-fit engine, stage-specific device planning, audio helpers
  • src/podcast_dub/tools/ — typed placement simulation and HTML turn-review tools that consume a pipeline workdir
  • tests/ — unit, regression, integration-audit, and Hypothesis property tests

Develop

uv run pytest                  # tests (testpaths configured in pyproject.toml)
uv run ruff format --check .   # formatting
uv run ruff check .            # lint (configured ruleset)
uv run ty check .              # types
uv build                       # source + wheel distributions

# audit the typed artifacts and media in a completed workdir
uv run python tests/generic_pipeline_test.py <workdir>

TODO

  • Investigate translation quality using multimodal LLMs (e.g. Gemma 4) that can consume audio directly, potentially replacing the separate ASR and LLM translation stages.

License

Apache-2.0 (see LICENSE). Model weights are governed by their own licenses (Qwen3-ASR/TTS: Apache-2.0; NVIDIA Sortformer: NVIDIA Open Model License).

content_html_zh:
使用所有开放权重模型将视频播客配音为另一种语言。

该管道主要可以在具有至少 16 GB RAM 的 M 系列 Mac 上本地运行。 翻译是主要限制，因为较大的法学硕士（超过 700 亿个参数）通常会产生更好的结果。 请随意尝试不同的法学硕士和配置！

  • 无字幕语音计时
  • 自动说话人分离（分类）
  • 流利的LLM翻译
  • 每个扬声器的语音克隆 TTS（最多 4 个扬声器）
  • 原始音频保留在下面，深沉

Demo

原来的 英语配音
观看原版 观看英语配音

配音本地视频

注意：您需要预安装 Git、uv 和 FFmpeg。

git clone https://github.com/cezarc1/podcast_dub.git
cd podcast_dub
uv sync --locked --python 3.12

然后，从存储库根目录：

uv run podcast_dub "./interview.mp4" --from zh --to en

通过 Moonshot 的 OpenAI 兼容 API 默认翻译为 Kimi K3。 DUB_TRANSLATE_API_KEY 必须已设置为相应的 API 密钥。

完整的管道运行并写入：

Path 内容
./interview_en.mp4 最终配音视频
./interview_dubwork/dub_mix.wav 完整的配乐，原始音频隐藏在下面
./interview_dubwork/dub_voice.wav 仅合成声音
./interview_dubwork/ 可恢复的阶段工件、日志和字幕

第一次运行会下载模型权重，可能需要一段时间。 本地输入必须是 FFmpeg 可以解码的媒体文件。 HTTP(S) 视频 URL 也被 yt-dlp 接受并下载到工作目录中。

使用作业文件

对于可重复的作业，创建 dub.toml：

video = "./interview.mp4"
source_lang = "zh"
target_lang = "en"
output = "./interview_en.mp4"
context = "A technical interview about database performance."
proper_nouns = ["AcmeDB", "Nova"]
speaker_names = ["host", "guest"]
# Names are assigned from most to least detected speaking time.

然后运行：

uv run podcast_dub --config dub.toml

配置模板请参见 dub.toml.example。 上面的演示具有可立即运行的配置，可进行五分钟的开发运行和完整的展示。

重新运行相同的作业会重用匹配的阶段工件。 如果源文件的内容发生更改而文件名未更改，请选择新的 --workdir，以便无法重复使用提取的源音频。 版本 0.1 尚未包含工件出处中的 ASR/NeMo 帮助器依赖项锁，因此在更改已安装的模型或推理依赖项后也可以使用新的工作目录。

配置翻译

Moonshot 和 Kimi K3 是默认值。 要使用其他 OpenAI 兼容服务，例如 OpenAI、OpenRouter 或 Ollama，请同时设置端点、模型和密钥：

export DUB_TRANSLATE_BASE_URL="https://provider.example/v1"
export DUB_TRANSLATE_MODEL="provider-model-id"
export DUB_TRANSLATE_API_KEY="<translation-api-key>"

DUB_TRANSLATE_BASE_URL 是 API 基 URL；不包括/聊天/完成。 管道附加操作路径。 当本地端点忽略身份验证时，仍然需要非空密钥，因此请使用该端点记录的占位符值。

对于可重复的作业，可以在 dub.toml 中设置 llm_base 和 llm_model；环境变量会覆盖一次性运行的这些值。 将密钥保留在 DUB_TRANSLATE_API_KEY 中，而不是将其存储在作业文件中。

配置的端点必须使用 OpenAI 兼容协议。 不支持直接的 Anthropic Messages API URL；使用 OpenAI 兼容网关（例如 OpenRouter）来运行 Claude 模型。

安装

先决条件：Python 3.12、uv 和 FFmpeg（ffmpeg 和 ffprobe）。

macOS / 苹果芯片

uv sync --locked --python 3.12

自动阶段规划是MPS上的ASR、CPU上的Sortformer二值化和MPS上的TTS。 macOS 上不使用 FlashAttention。

Linux/NVIDIA CUDA

安装前确认 NVIDIA 驱动程序可以正常工作：

nvidia-smi
uv sync --locked --python 3.12 --extra cuda

Linux 目前解决了该项目固定的 CUDA 13.0 PyTorch 轮子。 --extra cuda 为主 TTS 环境另外安装 FlashAttention；它不是 GPU 自动检测。

一个环境

每个阶段都在 uv 同步创建的单一环境中运行。 同步后无需构建帮助程序环境，也无需配置任何内容。

ASR、TTS 和二值化都在 Transformers 5.x 上运行。 这需要两件事：qwen-tts-compat，一个带有 Transformers 5.x 端口（上游硬引脚 4.57.3）的 qwen-tts 分支，以及一个 [tool.uv] 覆盖依赖项条目，因为 NeMo 声明了 Transformers~=4.57.0。 该引脚在这里是保守的而不是承载的：在 4.57.3 和 5.14.1 下对相同的音频进行分类会产生字节相同的片段。

覆盖是仅 uv 机制 - pip 没有等效机制，因此使用 uvsync 安装，而不是 pip install。

如果您希望在自己的解释器中运行任一阶段，DUB_ASR_PYTHON 和 DUB_NEMO_PYTHON 仍然可以工作；将他们指向它，那个阶段就在那里运行。

管道

视频 → 探测（16 kHz 音频）→ ASR 计时 → 二值化 → 克隆参考 → 翻译 → TTS → 放置 + 混合 → mp4

Stage 运行什么 Notes
probe ffmpeg 提取单声道 16 kHz 音频
asr Qwen3-ASR-1.7B + Qwen3-ForcedAligner 无标题短语 + 单词计时
日记化 NVIDIA Blackformer (NeMo) 最多四位发言者；在持续发言者切换时分割短语以减少发言者之间的 TTS
refs 从二值化自动挖掘 每个扬声器约 60 秒干净的独奏音频，完整时间线
翻译 DSPy + kimi-k3（Moonshot 默认） 修复语音 ASR 噪音，使用前面的源对话轮流，发出 TTS 就绪语音，并将每批记录到 <workdir>/translations.jsonl
tts Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B（本地） 阶段特定的 CUDA/MPS/CPU 选择、仅 x_vector 语音克隆、测量验证的 DSPy.Refine 重写循环
place ffmpeg + fit.py + 验证 锚链、硬质防漂移窗口、仅上限加速、侧链隐藏原始床；仅在覆盖/死机验证通过后才发布 mp4

CLI 在执行模型工作之前解析并打印特定于阶段的计划：

可用加速器 ASR汽车 自动二值化 TTS 自动
英伟达CUDA CUDA CUDA CUDA
苹果MPS MPS CPU MPS
none CPU CPU CPU

MPS和CPU使用热切关注。 CUDA ASR和TTS在安装并可导入时选择FlashAttention 2，否则选择SDPA； Sortformer 不消耗该注意力设置。 当需要特定加速器时，在 TOML 中显式设置 asr_device、diarize_device 和 tts_device。

这些是快速失败路由规则，并不保证每个驱动程序和包组合都有效。 在 CUDA 作业之前确认 nvidia-smi，并在每个完成的配音上运行最终媒体验证器。

固定 TTS 模型支持 zh、en、ja、ko、de、fr、ru、pt、es 和 it 作为目标语言。 参考挖掘需要每个检测到的说话者至少 30 秒的干净独奏语音，因此非常短或严重重叠的剪辑会很快失败，而不是产生微弱的语音克隆。

放置会自动运行覆盖范围和死气门。 它们也可以在检查现有工作目录时直接运行：

uv run python -m podcast_dub.stages.verify <workdir>

仓库布局

  • src/podcast_dub/ — 可安装包：cli.py（控制台入口点 podcast_dub）、types.py（Pydantic 合约）、artifacts.py（版本化/出处感知 I/O）、config.py、translate.py（DSPy 程序）以及 stage/ 中的管道阶段（asr、diarize、refs、translate、tts、place、verify）
  • src/podcast_dub/fit.py、device_utils.py、audio_utils.py — 时序适配引擎、特定阶段的设备规划、音频助手
  • src/podcast_dub/tools/ — 使用管道工作目录的类型化放置模拟和 HTML 回合审查工具
  • 测试/ — 单元、回归、集成审计和假设属性测试

发展

uv run pytest                  # tests (testpaths configured in pyproject.toml)
uv run ruff format --check .   # formatting
uv run ruff check .            # lint (configured ruleset)
uv run ty check .              # types
uv build                       # source + wheel distributions

# audit the typed artifacts and media in a completed workdir
uv run python tests/generic_pipeline_test.py <workdir>

执照

Apache-2.0（请参阅许可证）。 模型权重受其自己的许可证管辖（Qwen3-ASR/TTS：Apache-2.0；NVIDIA Sortformer：NVIDIA 开放模型许可证）。
